rules: SPI predicate(AccessRequest $request, string $resourceType, EvaluationContext $context, Grant|RoleContribution|null $contribution=null): AccessPredicate. AST all/any/not/eq/in/isNull/notNull/gte/lt/exists(relation,predicate), pass/deny/unsupported; partition(allow,deny,abstain) for policy, before uses deny/pass only. Identifiers compiled from validated known columns/relations, values bindings; no raw SQL text public AST. AST pure Kernel no Eloquent import. Adapter asserts exhaustive/disjoint semantics; SQL NULL normalizes explicitly. Typed branch evidence bound to concrete contribution before OR; compiler creates single nested where group no outer OR/host WHERE mutation.
guidance: Partitions NULL/bool/Response, literal SQL bindings, nested whereHas/exists, empty/all/any, unsafe identifier validation, host where preserved, before cannot produce authority. Queryable resource adapters use existing native API; external no model exact unsupported.
